picks.title: Nano Banana image generation comes to Google Earth
picks.excerpt: Google has integrated its Nano Banana image-generation model into Google Earth, letting users generate photorealistic renderings of historical sites (e.g. 'Pompeii in 78 AD') and pre-visualize future construction projects directly on the map. A concrete push of generative image AI into spatial design, architectural visualization, and place-based concept rendering workflows.
picks.rationale: Concrete new product feature that puts generative rendering directly into spatial/architectural pre-viz — high actionability and novelty from a credible outlet.

picks.title: Type designers have created a free font that poisons AI
picks.excerpt: Type designers have released ShieldFont, a free typeface engineered to corrupt AI model training on scraped text and imagery. A concrete craft-level response from the design/typography community to generative-AI data harvesting, giving designers a defensive tool against having their work ingested.
picks.rationale: A shipped, free, craft-level tool designers can use tomorrow to defend their work from training scrapers — novel and actionable.

picks.title: The Bull And Bear Case For Digital Design In The Age Of AI
picks.excerpt: Andy Budd examines how AI is reshaping product design: the bull case gives designers greater autonomy and less need for permission to act, while the bear case exposes the skill gaps that autonomy makes harder to hide. A framing piece for how design roles and workflows shift as AI removes handoff friction.
picks.rationale: Credible, well-argued framing from Andy Budd on how AI reshapes design roles and autonomy — a distinct Smashing article, not the earlier MacPaw piece.

picks.title: Your people get AI. Get out of their way
picks.excerpt: With every design org now reaching for the same AI tools, the argument is that the winners will be those willing to trust the practitioners who already understand them. A design-leadership / AX-adoption take on how teams should reorganize around AI rather than gatekeep it.
picks.rationale: A design-leadership angle on AX adoption that complements the more tactical picks; second figma-category card so it takes a distinct accent (#3b6bff).
